name: deribit_collector-mcp
description: Deribit options API (market data): me, search_symbols. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public API, no credentials: the probe is GET /public/test ({jsonrpc, id, result.version}).

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: get_instruments has no text search: `query` is sent as the REQUIRED `currency` parameter (BTC, ETH, USDC, USDT, EURR or any) and every non-expired instrument of that currency comes back in one response (kind future/option/spot/…; expired=false default; no pagination, `page`/`limit` ignored). `type` is the instrument kind; base_currency, quote_currency, is_active, expiration_timestamp, strike, option_type, tick_size, contract_size stay in `raw`. JSON-RPC errors arrive as {error: {code, message}} — 10028 is the rate limit.
